pages.title: Contraptions
pages.text: A **contraption** is a group of blocks moved as one: a drill carrying platform, a farm that drives itself, a train car. Glue and chassis decide what comes along; a mover decides how.

pages.title: Super Glue
pages.text: Bonds blocks into a shape. Blocks that hang on others need none. Click two corners to define an area.

pages.title: Linear Chassis
pages.text: Glues a row of blocks along its axis. The Radial Chassis grabs a disc around its axis. Both work with wrench settings and chassis ranges.

**Movers**:

- Piston: pushes along a line

- Rope Pulley: up and down

- Gantry: slides on a shaft

- Bearing: spins

- Cart Assembler: rides a minecart

pages.title: Mechanical Bearing
pages.text: Rotates a structure, for windmills, rotating drills and turntables. The Clockwork Bearing makes clock hands.

**Working parts**: Mechanical Drills, Saws, Harvesters and Ploughs do their job to whatever they pass. Deployers and funnels on the structure pull from and push into storage that moves with it.

Storage on a contraption is a chest or vault attached to the structure.

pages.title: Mechanical Drill
pages.text: Breaks blocks in front of it, also while moving. Harvesters cut crops, Ploughs till soil.

**Bigger things**: Create Aeronautics builds flying ships out of the same idea, see [#](2E5AAC)[Airships](entry://flight/airships)[#](). Trains are contraptions too, see [#](2E5AAC)[Trains](entry://transport/trains)[#]().
